name: SFL
comment: Regex-based TextMate grammar for SFL 1.2. Scope names are chosen to line up 1:1 with the token classes in frontend/src/features/sfl-language/sfl/highlight.ts (kw/kwc/layout/name/type/prop/str/num/const/comment/punct), and are colored to match that same palette via package.json's configurationDefaults (editor.tokenColorCustomizations, scoped to this language) — see that file for the exact hex values. Composition lists and property values use begin/end regions rather than single `match` rules, since a `: A & B & C` list or a `from: a.b, right (0.5)` value can contain an arbitrary number of tokens that each need their own scope.

block-header-container.comment: Project/Model/Group/Container/Chart/Symbol — blocks that may contain nested blocks (kwc). Chart (SFL 1.4 §5.4) nests Axis/Series/Rule; Symbol (§5.5) nests Port.

block-header-leaf.comment: Shape/Entity/Link/Layout/Style/Axis/Series/Rule/Path/Net/Port/Isometric/Connection/Text/Widget/Shader/DataSource — leaf blocks (kw). The Chart child kinds and the rest of the SFL 1.4 batch (Path §3.3, Net §3.5, Port §3.5) hold a fixed schema or no children rather than free content, so they're colored like Entity, not like a container keyword. The stickyflow.js 0.2 kinds (Text, Widget, Shader, DataSource) are leaves too.

composition-list.comment: The `: RefA & RefB` part of a block header (§8) — each ref gets its own token (`type` class).

subblock-header.comment: `layout {` / `style {` — a same-named property is disambiguated by the lack of a following '{'

property.comment: `key: value` through end of line or ';' (§5). Values are colored uniformly as `const`, matching the app's own lexical (non-resolving) highlighter — see semanticTokens.ts for why this deliberately isn't refined further.
